children: Overview
UK AI-native Finance ERP provider's H1 2026 revenue fell 12% yr/yr amid legacy product churn
Adjusted operating profit for H1 2026 rose 4% yr/yr, driven by cost efficiencies and SaaS transition
Company continues formal sale process, with advanced discussions underway with one party
Outlook
Company says macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty is extending sales cycles
Aptitude remains focused on converting its pipeline and upgrading clients to Fynapse
Board continues discussions with parties regarding a potential sale of the company
Result Drivers
FYNAPSE GROWTH - Co said strong momentum for Fynapse drove 12% AI Autonomous Finance ARR growth and 85% Fynapse ARR growth yr/yr
LEGACY CHURN - Co attributed overall ARR and revenue decline to elevated churn in legacy product portfolio
SAAS COST EFFICIENCIES - Co said transition to SaaS model delivered cost efficiencies, supporting higher operating margin
